g.text: A slanted line drawn across is labelled with its x at y -102.3, the top of the ink; a letter's slanted edge, drawn where it runs, with the x of the end its label stands at.

GENERAL in Anybody (anybody-150-900-italic.woff2) at size 150 on y 0, cap height 101.25 (capHeight 1350 of 2000 units in anybody-150-900-italic.woff2), so its cap line is at y −101.25. TRANSLATION in Anybody (anybody-150-500-italic.woff2), letter-spaced 2 and set at size 101.55 so its advance
equals GENERAL's (1109.18), on the baseline y2 = cap2 + gap = 68.54 + 40 = 108.54, so its cap line is at y 40 (Prototemplate scripts/build/speed-marks.mjs).

Cuts in a mask: through GENERAL at half its cap height (y −50.625), 0.053 of it high (5.37), written from y −53.3, 5.4 high; through TRANSLATION at half its cap height above its baseline (y 74.27), 0.07 of it high (4.8), written from y 71.9, 4.8 high.
The slash: 9 wide at 22° from the vertical, its left edge through x 631.67 at y 0, 0.57 of the way across the lettering's box (x 5.64 to 1103.95), from 20 above the lettering to 20 below.
The italic is the faces' italicAngle, 10° from the vertical.
The R's edge from x 667.2 at y −101.25 to x 649.35 at y 0 lies under the slash from y −77.61 to −38.16, where it is dotted: the mask hides it there.
These labels are the generator's values where the path, written to one decimal, reads otherwise (its reading in brackets): -101.25 (-101.2), 108.54 (108.5).
Of the letters' level edges only the cap lines, the baselines and the cuts are drawn; the crossbars and the A, N and R diagonals are the font's shapes and are left out.
